Privacy Policy
Last updated: 20 August 2026 · Version 3.0 · English version
This translation is provided for convenience. If it differs from the English text, the English version prevails.
1. Who we are

Kai is an AI assistant that configures and manages the user's CRM account on the user's instructions, delivered through the Telegram bot @aiicrm_bot (the "Service"). The data controller for the processing described in this Policy is Tsikhan Varabyou, the operator of the Service ("we", "us").

You can reach us about anything in this Policy at ai.crm.2000@gmail.com or via Telegram at @aiicrm_bot. We handle data-protection requests through the same channels we operate the Service on — no separate portal or form is required.
2. Scope and applicability

This Policy applies to personal data processed when you interact with the bot, connect your CRM account to it, or pay for a subscription. It does not govern the CRM platform you choose to connect, Telegram itself, or any other service you use alongside Kai — each has its own privacy terms.

The Policy is drafted on the framework of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). If you use the Service from outside the European Union, you are entitled to equivalent protections to the extent provided by the applicable data protection laws of your jurisdiction; nothing in this Policy limits rights those laws grant you, and references to GDPR articles should be read alongside their local counterparts.
3. Data we process, and where it comes from
We deliberately keep the data footprint narrow: the Service handles only what is needed to act on your instructions inside your CRM account. Specifically:
Category
Details
Source
CRM connection data
OAuth 2.0 access and refresh tokens (stored encrypted) and your account address (subdomain) on the CRM platform you choose to connect

Payment providers
Site analytics

A first-party cookie kai_vid — a pseudonymous visit identifier (one-year lifetime) — together with the pages viewed, the referring source and the language. Set only after you consent via the cookie banner; if you chose "Only necessary" or have not chosen yet, analytics never starts and nothing is sent. Used solely for our own site statistics; no third-party analytics services are integrated and the data is not shared with anyone. The legal basis is consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time through the "Cookie settings" link in the site footer
Your browser — after you consent to analytics
Strictly necessary storage

Your cookie choice (kai_cookie_consent) and your selected site language (kai_lang) are kept in browser localStorage. These are strictly necessary entries: they hold your own preferences, are never used for tracking and are never transmitted, so they do not require consent
Your browser

We never ask for, receive, or store your CRM login or password. Access to your CRM account works exclusively through OAuth 2.0 via the platform's official API, and you can revoke it at any moment in your CRM platform's integration settings — the token is invalidated immediately.
4. Why we process it, and on what legal basis
Under Article 6 GDPR (and the corresponding provisions of other applicable data protection laws), each processing operation rests on one of the following bases:

Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) — connecting your CRM account, interpreting your messages, executing the CRM actions you request, importing the files you upload, and managing your subscription. This is the core of the Service: without this processing, Kai cannot do what you ask it to do.

Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) — keeping technical logs needed to diagnose failures, prevent abuse of the bot, and secure the Service. We log the minimum required for these purposes and do not use logs for profiling.
Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) — any processing that is genuinely optional, such as product announcements sent through the bot. You can withdraw consent at any time without affecting the Service.
We do not sell personal data, do not share it with advertisers, and do not use it to train our own or anyone else's models.
5. Recipients and international transfers
Kai relies on a small set of processors, grouped by category, each receiving only what its function requires:
What it receives
Purpose
The CRM platform you connect
The API calls needed to execute your instructions in your account, made through the platform's official API
Reading and writing the CRM objects you asked for
AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic)
The text of your requests and, for voice messages, the audio for transcription. Your OAuth tokens and credentials are never included in these calls
Understanding your messages and generating responses and plans
Payment providers (card processing, Telegram Stars, USDT crypto payments)
The data each provider needs to process your payment
Subscription billing. Card details stay with the processor; we only see the confirmation

Some of these providers operate outside the European Economic Area. Where personal data leaves the EEA, the transfer is safeguarded by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an equivalent lawful transfer mechanism maintained by the provider. For users outside the EU, transfers are carried out in accordance with the applicable data protection laws of your jurisdiction.
6. How long we keep data
OAuth tokens — until you disconnect the integration or delete your data; revoked tokens are invalidated immediately and purged.
Conversation history and generated plans — while your account with the bot is active, so context is preserved between sessions; deleted on request.
Uploaded files (Excel/CSV, images) — only as long as needed to complete the operation you requested (for example an import), then removed.
Voice messages — sent for transcription and not retained after the text transcript is produced.
Billing records — for the period required by accounting and tax law applicable to us.
Technical logs — for a short rolling window sufficient for security and debugging, after which they are overwritten.
7. Your rights
Under the GDPR — and, for users elsewhere, under the applicable data protection laws of your jurisdiction — you may at any time:
Access the personal data we hold about you and receive a copy;
Rectify inaccurate data;
Erase your data — write to ai.crm.2000@gmail.com or use the /delete command in the bot;
Receive your data in a portable, machine-readable format;
Object to processing based on legitimate interest;
Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority — for EEA residents, the data protection authority of your member state; elsewhere, the body designated by your local law.

When you request deletion, we remove your conversation history, OAuth tokens, generated plans, and the link between your Telegram account and your CRM account. Objects already created inside your CRM account (pipelines, fields, contacts and so on) belong to that account and remain there — you manage them through your CRM platform directly.
Revoking CRM access does not require contacting us at all: disable the connection in your CRM platform's settings and the Service loses access instantly.
8. Security

OAuth tokens are stored encrypted at rest. Transport between the bot, our servers, the CRM platform, and every processor uses TLS. Access to production data is restricted to the operator and is not shared with third parties outside the processors listed above. We follow a data-minimisation approach: the Service does not request CRM permissions it does not use, and does not copy your CRM database to our servers — it operates on your data inside your account, on your instruction.
9. Children

The Service is a business tool and is not directed at anyone under 16. We do not knowingly process minors' data; if you believe a minor has used the Service, contact us and we will delete the associated data.
10. Changes to this Policy

When we materially change this Policy, we will notify active users through the bot and update the version and date at the top of this page. The current version is always available at this address. Continued use of the Service after a change takes effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.
11. Contact
Email: ai.crm.2000@gmail.com
Telegram: @aiicrm_bot

Refund & Cancellation Policy
Last updated: 20 August 2026 · English version
This translation is provided for convenience. If it differs from the English text, the English version prevails.

This Refund & Cancellation Policy (the "Policy") describes billing, renewal, cancellation and refund terms for the Kai AI service (the "Service"), available through the Telegram bot @aiicrm_bot. It forms an integral part of our Terms of Service.

In short: the first 3 days are free with no charge. You can cancel anytime. If something goes wrong, email ai.crm.2000@gmail.com within 7 days and we will refund you if less than 30% of the paid allowance was used.
1. Billing model

The Service is provided on a subscription basis for the selected period (30 days), paid in advance. Prices are shown in euros (EUR) on the pricing page. Each plan includes a defined allowance of actions (requests) and set of features.
New users get a free trial of 3 (three) calendar days. No charge is made during the trial; if you stop using the Service before it ends, you pay nothing.
The licence or subscription for the CRM platform you connect is paid by you separately, at that platform's own rates, and is not part of the Service or of any amount charged under this Policy.
2. Renewal and cancellation
2.1. Renewal

When paying via auto-renewing methods, the subscription renews automatically for the next period at the current price until you cancel. When paying via one-off methods (Telegram Stars, USDT cryptocurrency), access is granted for the paid period and does not auto-renew — to continue, you pay again.
2.2. How to cancel
You may cancel at any time by:
emailing ai.crm.2000@gmail.com;
managing the subscription in your payment provider (for auto-renewing methods);
simply stopping use of the Service (one-off methods do not renew on their own).
2.3. Effect of cancellation

After cancellation, access to paid features remains until the end of the already-paid period; it then does not renew and no further charges are made. Cancellation is not an automatic refund for the current period — refund terms are set out below.
3. Refunds
3.1. When a refund is available
We will refund your payment if at least one of the following applies:
you contact us within 7 (seven) calendar days of payment and have used less than 30% of the paid action allowance for the period;
the Service materially failed to match its described functionality and we did not resolve it within a reasonable time after your report;
a payment was charged in error or duplicated.
3.2. When a refund is not available
30% or more of the paid allowance for the period has been used;
more than 7 days have passed since payment (except for a material breach by us or an erroneous charge);
access was terminated for your breach of the Terms of Service (fraud, unauthorized access, abuse, etc.);
the payment for the same period was already refunded.
4. EU consumer rights

If you are a consumer in the European Union, you have a 14-day right of withdrawal. Because the Service is a digital service available immediately upon payment, by starting to use the paid features you expressly consent to the immediate performance of the service and acknowledge that you lose the 14-day withdrawal right for the part already performed (Art. 16(m) of EU Directive 2011/83/EU). This does not limit your rights where the service is materially non-conforming.
5. How to request a refund

Email ai.crm.2000@gmail.com with the subject "Refund" and include: your Telegram username or ID, the date and method of payment, the plan, and the reason. We review requests within 5 (five) business days.
6. How refunds are processed

An approved refund is issued via the original payment method, typically within 5–10 business days (crediting time depends on your bank/provider). For cryptocurrency payments, refunds are made in USDT to the wallet you specify; exchange-rate differences and network fees are not compensated.
7. Chargebacks
Before opening a dispute with your bank, please contact us — most issues are resolved faster directly. Disputing a legitimate charge for a service already rendered may result in access restrictions.
8. Changes to this Policy
We may update this Policy. The current version is always published on this page with its update date. Payments already made are governed by the version in force at the time of payment.
